title: Frugal Adoption Path: Field Labs & Operational Playbook for Batching, Caching, and Quantization
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: This initiative defines an adoption path and operational playbook to take successful cost-saving experiments (batching heuristics, KV/prefix caching, 4-bit quant profiles) from experiments to repeatable production rollouts via 'Field Labs'. The goal is to reduce token cost per request by 10-30% for latency-tolerant endpoints while preserving P95 latency SLOs. Deliverables: playbook, gating metrics, rollout templates, dashboard panels, and a vendor-agnostic quant profile baseline.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Runbook published and reviewed by SRE and Runtime teams. 2) Two Field Labs complete with >10% cost reduction and <5% quality regression on canary prompt sets. 3) Rollout automation templates in infra-repo and Console feature flags. 4) Dashboard panels for token-econ and quality alerts live in Grafana.
decisions: 1) Prioritize batching-first trials for chat-like low-latency endpoints with tail-latency controls. 2) Use adaptive TTLs for KV cache per-model determined by sample entropy. 3) Standardize on two quant profiles (4-bit dynamic & 8-bit fallback) for canary rollouts.

notes: Trade-offs: aggressive quantization yields larger cost savings but increases output tokenization artifacts for long-form generation. Batching reduces per-token compute but can increase latency spikes; mitigation: latency budget-aware dynamic batching and small-batch bypass for high-priority requests.
